{{Quote|A BT-7, if I'm not mistaken. One of the Pollad designs&mdash;a very fine vessel, appropriate for the Republic's best.|M1-4X|<ref name="Unbridled Enthusiasm">{{TORcite|type=conversation|M1-4X|Unbridled Enthusiasm}}</ref>}}
'''Ryden Pollad''' was an eccentric [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designer who worked for the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] company [[Rendili Hyperworks/Legends|Rendili Hyperworks]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> where the designer developed the [[BT-7 Thunderclap]] assault craft<ref name="Unbridled Enthusiasm" /> for the [[Republic Army]]'s [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces Division]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Pollad's style was well known in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[M1-4X]] was able to identify the Thunderclap as the work of the Rendili designer immediately upon sighting the vessel.<ref name="Unbridled Enthusiasm" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ryden Pollad was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]],<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> and the game's [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' identified Pollad's first name.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
